Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood marketplace renewal — next steps for acceptance window

Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the execs liked the performance numbers on the dedicated pools. Procurement asked me to reach out about two items before we can schedule acceptance:

1) Can you confirm whether the private offer will allow a 30-day staged activation (we plan to ramp 40%/60%)?
2) We need a PO template that includes the marketplace contract id and the private offer reference for our AP team.

If those look good, we can route the PO internally and get a DocuSign ready for signature.

Also — small ask: if acceptance misses the target window, do you have a fallback to cover burst traffic for July? We want to avoid service disruption during the pilot.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Cloud Ops, Cedar Labs

Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood marketplace renewal — next steps for acceptance window

Daniel —

Great to hear the execs are aligned. Short answers up front:

- Staged activation: yes — we can support a 30-day staged activation (40% initial, remaining 60% at day 15) and will bake the ramp plan into the private offer metadata so marketplace activation honors the split.
- PO template: attaching a PO template (filled example and blank). Please have your AP include the marketplace offer id (included in the attached terms PDF).
- Acceptance fallback: we can provide a short-term burst allowance on Redwood Dedicated for up to 14 days if acceptance slips; that will be covered under the private offer as an emergency burst credit. We should document the trigger thresholds (e.g., 20% sustained over expected baseline) — see notes below.

I've looped in Priyom for the marketplace acceptance playbook and Kimberly for legal/billing signoff.

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi: Send PO template + private offer terms (attached) — DONE.
- Daniel: Confirm PO fields and internal routing timeline.
- Priyom/Kimberly: Quick review of acceptance/credits language and DocuSign flow.

Attachments: Cedar_PO_Template.xlsx (blank + filled example), Redwood_PrivateOffer_Terms_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi / Daniel — quick operational notes from my side:

- We'll add the staged-activation schedule to the private offer metadata as an "activation_schedule" field (40/60 split, target day-15 completion). This ensures marketplace provisioning follows the ramp and avoids double-billing.
- For the burst fallback: Redwood Dedicated can pre-authorize a 14-day emergency burst at up to 25% additional capacity. We will gate the burst by an SLO-based trigger (sustained throughput > 120% of agreed baseline for 24 hours) and notify both parties 2 hours before enforcement. That will be set as an opt-in clause in the PO.
- DocuSign flow: we recommend the following sign order — Cedar Labs (AP), Cedar Labs (Legal), Redwood Legal, Redwood Finance. If Cedar prefers a single-signer route to speed things up, note that AP must confirm internal authority.

I attached the internal acceptance playbook excerpt for reference (not required in the carrier).

Priyom
Head of Marketplace Integrations, Redwood Inference

Rishi / Priyom / Kimberly —

This is helpful, thanks. A couple of clarifications from procurement:

- They want the private offer reference explicitly shown on the PO and on the invoice. Is that something you can guarantee from the marketplace side?
- AP also asked whether the 14-day burst would incur a separate invoice line or be applied as a credit against the committed capacity. Preferably we keep it as a credit so it doesn't create a separate PO line.

We plan to route the PO next Tuesday (2028-06-12) and aim to have DocuSign completed by 2028-06-19 so the staged activation can kick off on 2028-06-21. If you can confirm the PO fields and the credit treatment, we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Daniel

Daniel —

Confirming the two procurement items:

1) Private offer reference on PO/invoice: yes — marketplace will pass the private offer id through the invoice metadata. We've added a line in the terms PDF (see section 2.1) clarifying where the offer id will appear.

2) Burst treatment: the 14-day emergency burst will be recorded as a credit line against the committed capacity (not a separate payable line) — that credit will appear on the invoice as "Emergency Burst Credit" with a negative value and an explanatory note. This keeps AP flow clean.

Action items for Cedar AP:
- Use the attached PO template and populate the "Marketplace Offer ID" field with the ID from the private offer (Rishi will provide the ID once the private offer is provisioned).
- Confirm sign order and who will be the initial DocuSign recipient. If you want to expedite, list the AP signer first and mark legal as reviewer.

If Cedar needs a short call to confirm wording, I'm available Monday morning (PDT).

Best,
Kimberly Park
